name: Owl – Night Owl, Retired
title: Owl – Night Owl, Retired Ornament
story: This owl ornament is for the former night owl who is now in bed by nine: a sleepy owl in a nightcap and scarf, and an easy Christmas stocking gift for a tired friend, parent or coworker.

The print is a droopy-eyed owl in a striped nightcap and scarf on a pine branch, with a crescent moon behind it, under NIGHT OWL, RETIRED in heavy slab capitals in cream and orange on a deep midnight-blue disc. The art matches our Night Owl, Retired hoodie, so the ornament makes a set with the hoodie.

Everyone knows someone who used to stay up until two and now calls ten o'clock a late night. The ornament says it in three words and one very tired bird. Hang it on a sturdy branch, tuck it into a stocking, or tie it to a gift for the person who falls asleep during the movie. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.
joke_a: Night owl is what people called you at twenty-two, and retired is what the couch says now. The Night Owl, Retired ornament from Graphic Tees Co. prints a sleepy owl in a nightcap and scarf, so anyone who is in bed by nine gets the joke at a glance.
